title: Nathan B NDE 4783
content: On December 26, 2006, I had an accident. I was clinically dead when my heart stopped for nine minutes. I was pronounced dead after six minutes of doctors trying to resuscitate me. It's only because a trainee nurse was given the opportunity to practice resuscitation on me after the doctors had stopped that I came back - how lucky was that! It makes me wonder about fate. My brain was starved of oxygen for some time but fortunately, as a result, I only suffer for some memory loss in which I can't remember periods of my life beforehand. Also something has happened since which at times I wonder if I gained an ability or a curse either way I have a better knowledge of things I find it a little scary and confusing. I'm looking for people who can help me to understand and people who know about the paranormal. During my experience, it started as an outer body one; I was sat on the bed next to the one I was lying on watching myself being resuscitated. Then I was being pulled by my shoulders from behind. I turned my head to look and all I could see was darkness as if I was being taken into a dark cave. Then I remember as if I was roaming in this dark place with some small almost flash memories of other things, not people but (don't know hard to explain) I remember that it felt as if I was there for a very long time. I remember calling out and screaming in this place and remember not being heard, the more I think about it, it seems as if I was there for a lifetime. When I came around, I was on my hospital bed in the intensive care unit ward where I had been for two days. Since then, I feel like I have some kind of a very sensitive sense to things.
